verdict.rationale: Gide states an early-stage financing practice: it structures, negotiates and drafts financing documentation "from seed capital to IPOs" for entrepreneurs and investors. It backs this with roughly 70 transactions a year and a Chambers Band 1 venture capital ranking. However, nothing in the evidence mentions SAFEs, convertible notes or French equivalents such as BSA AIR, nor any explainers or forms. Missing for 10: any explicit SAFE or convertible-instrument experience, published explainers or template forms, pre-seed-specific practice detail, and independent corroboration of seed-stage convertible deals.
